entry.title: EU Proposes Quantum Act to Turn Research Into Products
entry.summary: The draft would coordinate national programmes and enable a tech equity fund, but allocates no fixed budget and still needs lawmakers’ approval.

entry.title: SBI, SMFG Launch Solana Venture for Onchain Finance
entry.summary: The former SBI R3 Japan will target stablecoin payments and tokenized assets, establishing Japanese use cases before expanding overseas.

entry.title: HKMA Launches CMU Platform for Tokenized Bond Settlement
entry.summary: Ten banks have joined the permissioned system, while connections to tokenized deposits and regulated stablecoins remain on its expansion roadmap.

entry.title: French Senate Rejects €100,000 Crypto Wallet Rule
entry.summary: Senators also rejected proposals to tax gains on swaps into certain stablecoins and extend the exit tax to crypto. The 2027 budget remains under debate.

entry.title: MON Hits Record Low After First Insider Lockup Ends
entry.summary: About 16.6 billion MON became eligible for release under Monad's vesting schedule—roughly 1.4 times its pre-unlock circulating supply.

entry.title: Taiwan Stocks Sink as Much as 8.6% After 9% Rally
entry.summary: TAIEX pared its loss to 7.1% in late-morning trading, while TSMC and Foxconn also sank following a US chip-stock selloff.

entry.title: FinCEN Confirms Intrusion, Keeps BSA Filing Website Open
entry.summary: The Treasury bureau says some systems are offline. A Nov. 24 order gives qualifying automated filers more time, but suspicious-activity monitoring must continue.

entry.title: Liquity Says V2 ETH Branch Is in Safety Mode Near 149%
entry.summary: The protocol reported about 149% collateralization, below the 150% Safety Mode threshold that restricts withdrawals and new debt.

entry.title: Trump Says He Lobbied Nvidia Board for Huang’s Return
entry.summary: The president told the WSJ that Nvidia’s falling stock helped his push. Directors reinstated Huang while their independent inquiry remained open.

entry.title: Trezor Says Firmware Blocks Known Spying Implants
entry.summary: The Nov. 11 update cannot protect a recovery phrase already captured, Trezor says. Users holding funds on CryptoBilis-supplied devices bought from March 2026 onward are still advised to move them to a new wallet.

entry.title: New York Enacts Five-Year Ban on AI Companion Toys
entry.summary: The ban takes effect February 22, 2027, leaving this holiday season outside the moratorium. It covers children's toys with embedded or integrated AI companions.

entry.title: Morpho Borrow Rate Doubled Amid Spark Liquidity Pullback
entry.summary: Spark cut its position in a Base lending market by about 468 million USDC. The pool's daily-average borrow rate rose above 10% before easing.

entry.title: Huawei Convicted on 10 Counts, Acquitted of Racketeering Conspiracy
entry.summary: The Brooklyn jury rejected two conspiracy charges. Huawei’s lawyer said the company would appeal the convictions.

entry.title: Hut 8 Says Beacon Point Phase 2 Cleared for Construction
entry.summary: The company says site preparation is underway at its Texas AI campus. ERCOT is separately targeting Dec. 10 for its final community-impact report.

entry.title: Dell Lifts Outlook as AI Server Sales Hit $22 Billion
entry.summary: The hardware supplier reported a $132.3 billion AI server backlog and raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS forecast midpoint to $29.68 from $25.50.

entry.title: Stablecoin Market Shrinks About $17 Billion in 30 Days
entry.summary: DefiLlama's dashboard shows a 5.73% contraction, with USDT, USDC and Sky's USDS among the major stablecoins shrinking.

entry.title: Ethereum Foundation Backs Keccak-256 for Quantum Shift
entry.summary: Advances in proof generation underpin the Foundation's choice of an established hash, but the recommendation is not an adopted network upgrade.

entry.title: OpenAI Reports Lab Binders From GPT-6.2 Protein Designs
entry.summary: The company says 35 of 322 proteins showed binding in tests with Onava. Specialized models supplied sequences and screened candidates; biological function remains untested.

entry.title: Kraken’s Krak Plans US Credit Cards With USDC Option
entry.summary: The top 4% cashback tier requires a $150,000 Krak balance and Krakpass membership. The secured card will lock USDC while earning variable yield.

entry.title: Sei v6.8 Adds CosmWasm Shutdown Controls Ahead of Giga
entry.summary: The mandatory mainnet upgrade removes legacy Cosmos modules, but leaves both new contract-shutdown controls inactive.

entry.title: Gemini Announces Shielded Zcash Deposits Via Ironwood
entry.summary: Gemini says customers can now deposit to shielded receiving addresses, adding to its existing Ironwood withdrawal support.

entry.title: SEC Staff Give Molecule No-Action Relief for Token Sales
entry.summary: The research-funding model separates advisory-vote tokens from company equity, with no token-holder priority in a future share offering.

entry.title: Claude Adds MCP Skills and Long-Running Task Support
entry.summary: Skills over MCP enters public beta. Tasks and Elicitation are generally available on Pro, Max and Ultra, with Team and Enterprise rolling out.

entry.title: Ledn Moves US Business Onshore, Adds BitGo Custody
entry.summary: The account adds bank-funded bitcoin purchases executed by BitGo. Trading and lending are subject to state eligibility.

entry.title: Utah Seeks to Drop Charges After Kalshi Blocks New Trades in the State
entry.summary: The dismissal request covers the company and its co-founders, but prosecutors could refile if Kalshi resumes offering prediction markets in Utah.

entry.title: Bullpen Reports Unauthorized Transfers in 18–19 Accounts
entry.summary: The affected accounts date to the app's early beta and include Ansem's. Bullpen said it had taken the affected test service offline.

entry.title: Osmosis Restricts 84,000 Wallets After Web3Auth Breach
entry.summary: A validator-installed patch permits recovery-only transfers for listed wallets and indefinitely freezes 64 accounts Osmosis links to the attacker.

entry.title: Tidal to Ban Fully AI-Generated Music From December 9
entry.summary: The streaming service expects to delete 29 million songs by the start of 2027, while continuing to accept music made with AI assistance.

entry.title: DOJ Details Crypto Cases in Broad Anti-Scam Crackdown
entry.summary: The campaign spans more than 400 cases. DOJ's claim of over $8 billion in 'intended loss' does not establish how much was seized or returned to victims.

entry.title: Nvidia Falls 8% After Rally on Huang's Return as CEO
entry.summary: The stock retained much of Monday's 31.5% gain, while a steeper decline in a chip-stock ETF showed the retreat extended beyond Nvidia.

entry.title: US Blacklists Megaspeed, Tightening Access to AI Chips
entry.summary: Commerce's licensing restrictions reach suppliers beyond Nvidia. The action came the same day Jensen Huang returned as CEO.

entry.title: Euler Technologies Replaces Labs in Commercial Push
entry.summary: Christopher Cameron joins as head of strategy as the new provider takes over development and the app. Administrative permissions are due to transfer by November’s end.

entry.title: Fidelity Crypto Adds AAVE, LINK and UNI to Its Lineup
entry.summary: Eligible customers can trade the tokens in individual, joint and crypto IRA accounts, with Oregon excluded and a 1% fee on buys and sells.

entry.title: Coinkite Explains Why Coldcard Flaw Escaped Checks
entry.summary: The wallet maker’s postmortem describes a missed firmware-routing error. Fixed firmware cannot repair old seeds, and customer compensation remains undecided.

entry.title: Bisq 2 Urges Security Update Ahead of Network Cutoff
entry.summary: New signature rules take effect at 7 p.m. ET on Nov. 24. The latest desktop release also patches a Java flaw that could allow attackers to run code.

entry.title: Deel Launches Stablecoin Spending Card in 26 Markets
entry.summary: The Stripe-powered Visa card lets eligible contractors spend DLUSD balances without first moving funds to a bank. Employee access is coming soon.

entry.title: UniCredit Offers Bitcoin Note With Maturity Protection
entry.summary: Eligible UniCredit retail clients in Italy can subscribe through the bank’s advisory service from €1,000. Standard maturity terms cap gains at 65% over six years; repayment depends on UniCredit’s ability to pay.

entry.title: Aave Horizon Adds HINC High-Yield Fund as Collateral
entry.summary: Eligible holders can borrow USDC, GHO and RLUSD without redeeming the fund, with standard initial borrowing capped at 55% of collateral value.

entry.title: Uber, Nuro and Lucid Start Driverless Tests in Bay Area
entry.summary: Driverless employee rides are next as the partners target a first-quarter 2027 public launch, later than the 2026 debut previously planned.

entry.title: New York Judge Declines to Halt Kalshi Trading for Now
entry.summary: Justice Melissa Crane sought fuller arguments on a preliminary injunction, without settling whether New York can apply gambling laws to Kalshi’s contracts.

entry.title: OKXICE Opens 24/7 Stock Trading With Six Live Tokens
entry.summary: The six Uniswap v4 pools held about $1.22 million after opening day. OKX's confirmed 113-asset total rollout lineup includes current listings.

entry.title: OKX Australia Opens Stock and Commodity Perps to Retail
entry.summary: The expansion brings round-the-clock exposure to stocks and commodities under a 2x leverage cap, without ownership of the underlying assets.

entry.title: Compound Curbs Snapshot Voting After 'No' Leads Advisory Poll
entry.summary: The Foundation-backed framework limits offchain voting to approved addresses. Voting through Compound's onchain Governor remains unchanged.

entry.title: Polygon PoS Plans 'Mini-Blocks' for Faster Inclusion
entry.summary: Producers will check for transactions roughly every 100–200 milliseconds, but later arrivals paying higher tips won’t jump ahead of earlier batches.

entry.title: Sun-Linked Wallet Moves $1.49 Billion From Sky to Aave
entry.summary: Ethereum transactions trace a concentrated exit from Sky savings and a rewards farm into Aave, as Spark unwound lending positions to replenish Sky's exchange reserve.

entry.title: GPT-6.2 Astra Scores Higher With Codex in Robot-Arm Tests
entry.summary: Independent tests show gains in robot control, but the software harness, partial-credit scoring and simulation-driven saturation trend change what the headline numbers mean.

entry.title: FT Names Five Directors Leading Tesla–SpaceX Merger Talks
entry.summary: Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs advise SpaceX and Evercore advises Tesla, the FT says; the sides still need to settle the share-exchange ratio.

entry.title: JPMorgan, HSBC Test Digital Gold Settlement in London
entry.summary: StoneX joined legally binding transactions that tested trading, settlement and collateral use of fractional gold interests, the World Gold Council said.

entry.title: DRW Plans Outside-Money Business for Compute and Crypto
entry.summary: Bloomberg reported that the Cumberland parent is building an asset management business in London, extending beyond trading its own capital.

entry.title: edgeX Scraps Vault Rule Changes, Keeps Fixed 7% APR
entry.summary: The exchange withdrew its planned shift to profit-and-loss sharing ahead of a depositor opt-in deadline, citing community feedback.

entry.title: Anthropic Slips Below $83 IPO Price in Premarket Trade
entry.summary: ANT's early low was about 27% below its first-day opening trade, days after the Claude developer went public.

entry.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Staff Fear New Model Releases: Axios
entry.summary: Insiders are divided between those who think control problems can be fixed and those who want training stopped, according to the report.

entry.title: Lookonchain Flags Suspected Hack of Ansem-Linked Wallet
entry.summary: The tracker reported 2.15 million USDC moved to Arbitrum. Records link 1.55 million USDC directly to the Ansem-associated wallet through Relay.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Set Monthly Record at $4.71 Billion
entry.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT accounted for about 89% of the Nov. 23 net withdrawal, pushing November’s running total past June’s full-month record.

entry.title: South Korea Proposes ICO Return, Exchange Ownership Cap
entry.summary: The FSC would initially limit domestic issuance of won-pegged stablecoins to bank-majority consortia. Its proposed 20% exchange ownership cap allows exceptions.

entry.title: BlackRock Opens Hong Kong Fund to Stablecoin Payments
entry.summary: The HKD Digital Liquidity Fund offers tokenized units from HK$10, but its stablecoin payment route is for professional investors.

entry.title: Lighter Bridge TVL Falls 14.4% as USDC Balance Shrinks
entry.summary: DefiLlama recorded 82.8 million fewer USDC tokens over Nov. 15–22. Aster Bridge, one selected comparator, posted a smaller 3.6% TVL decline.

entry.title: Reuters: Circle, World Liberty Ordered to Keep Tokens Frozen
entry.summary: An ADGM order requires 18 firms to preserve Binance hack-linked tokens, Reuters reported. A Dec. 1 hearing will consider whether the restrictions continue.

entry.title: AI-Designed Tests Improve but Still Fall Short for METR
entry.summary: Some model-made evaluations earned borderline-positive ratings, but none was useful enough for METR's latest report. Its task-horizon trend still shows rapid gains.

entry.title: How Chips Are Made: From Design to Tested Hardware
entry.summary: Tape-out hands a design to a manufacturer. Fabrication, packaging, qualification and volume production describe different steps—not interchangeable promises of deliveries.

entry.title: Ten Under Formal Investigation in Paris Gold-Crypto Probe
entry.summary: Investigators say stolen customer records were used to solicit asset transfers and home collections under the guise of safekeeping.

entry.title: Yield Basis Activates propAMM on Active Bitcoin Pools
entry.summary: Existing WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC positions need no migration, the protocol says. Qualifying trades can pay less than the policy's 2% fallback fee.

entry.title: UK Qualifying Crypto Venues Face Own-Platform Market-Making Ban
entry.summary: Market making in qualifying cryptoassets on qualifying platforms will be excluded from principal-dealing permission. Separate final FCA rules bar firms from making markets on UK qualifying platforms they operate from Oct. 25, 2027.

entry.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Limits on AI Development
entry.summary: Jakub Pachocki wants labs to tie further pretraining gains to better monitoring, using newly disclosed internal measurements as a starting point.

entry.title: Wiz Says Attacker Mined AI Coding Histories for Logins
entry.summary: Wiz matched cloud-intrusion telemetry with an attacker's exposed files, which also revealed broader credential harvesting.

entry.title: Jito Plan Puts Foundation First for New Network Fees
entry.summary: JIP-40 links DAO sharing of emerging revenues to a $20 million annual threshold, while preserving existing DAO income and JTX buybacks.

entry.title: Microsoft Outage Review Finds Gaps in Server Testing
entry.summary: All queued enterprise email was delivered, Microsoft says, but some messages to inactive consumer mailboxes expired.

entry.title: CFTC Finalizes Reporting Rules for Event Contracts
entry.summary: The rule gives qualifying contracts a futures-style reporting framework, while requiring exchanges to collect trader identities and publish trade data.

entry.title: Epoch AI Rates Three Agent Benchmarks as 'Flawed'
entry.summary: Epoch found full-credit shortcuts in 22 of 50 sampled Agents' Last Exam tasks. Its latest reviews also flagged Vending-Bench 2 and ARC-AGI-3.

entry.title: Chainflip Suspects Key Theft in $12.6 Million Vault Hack
entry.summary: The first report identifies validly signed transfers outside the protocol but leaves parts of the suspected key theft unconfirmed. Services remain paused.

entry.title: Baidu Opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview Under Apache 2.0
entry.summary: The 280-billion-parameter model can be self-hosted and fine-tuned for commercial use. Its permissive license does not extend to ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base.

entry.title: Anthropic Opens Beta for Zero-Retention AI Safeguards
entry.summary: Once EFS takes effect, Anthropic says its normal workflow promptly deletes its own prompt and response copies after writing encrypted records to customer storage.

entry.title: Tesla Opens Cybercab Rides in Dallas, Its Second City
entry.summary: The two-seat vehicle expands beyond Austin after federal regulators opened an inquiry into Tesla’s safety certification.

entry.title: Watchdog Links Trump Dinner Wallets to Exchanges Barring US Users
entry.summary: Public Citizen found at least 66 of 130 listed wallets received TRUMP directly from exchanges that restrict US users. The transfers do not establish holders’ nationalities.

entry.title: Trump Threatens to Tax US Firms That Build Data Centers Abroad
entry.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Nov. 22 he had not discussed the threat with Trump. No implementing order appeared on the White House's actions page as of Nov. 23.

entry.title: CFTC Alleges Backward Hat Ran Forex Ponzi Using Crypto
entry.summary: The agency says the forex investment pool sent about $91 million to a Coinbase account. A court has frozen assets and appointed a receiver.

entry.title: Sonic Reports 4.70 Billion S, 48% Above Launch Figure
entry.summary: A planned 91.7 million S burn amounts to about 2% of the reported total. Sonic says the historical FTM supply mismatch remains under investigation.

entry.title: Samsung Wallet USDC Sends on Sui Go Live, Sui Says
entry.summary: The rollout adds a network option to Samsung's existing stablecoin account. New York residents are excluded, and identity checks are required.

entry.title: Amazon Agrees to Buy Decart AI Tech and Hire Its Team
entry.summary: Calcalist values the technology-and-team deal at $7.5 billion. Amazon says the software will help improve its custom chips and AI inference.

entry.title: ECB Approves Wider Tokenized Collateral Access for 2027
entry.summary: Implementation is planned for June 2027. Securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s DLT Pilot Regime must meet standard collateral criteria and connect to existing settlement infrastructure.

entry.title: Oregon, Virginia Sue SpaceX Over Grok Image Safeguards
entry.summary: The states allege misleading safety assurances over sexualized images of real people, including children, and are seeking civil penalties and injunctions.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Fix and Approve Code
entry.summary: The beta adds agents for GitHub pull requests on Team and Enterprise plans. Human sign-off depends on a team's policy and repository rules.

entry.title: Sierra Announces $1.75B Raise at a $30B Valuation
entry.summary: The AI customer-service company's valuation is nearly twice its reported May valuation, as Sierra reports more than $400 million in annual recurring revenue.

entry.title: Anthropic Publishes Claude's Claimed VP ≠ VNP Proof
entry.summary: The official release includes Lean 4 code and passing automated checks, but Anthropic says no human mathematician has checked the proof.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000, Erasing Monday's Rebound
entry.summary: The evening low on Coinbase was 8% below Monday's peak and 30% below its Oct. 21 high, but remained above the weekend trough.

entry.title: Aave Horizon’s USCC Balance Fell 74%; TVL Rebounded
entry.summary: Most of the USCC decline occurred by early November; TVL rebounded on Nov. 23. Outstanding borrowing remained about 24% below its late-October level.

entry.title: Hong Kong Gazettes Bill to Expand Crypto Licensing
entry.summary: Dealers, advisers, managers and custodians would need SFC approval. The bill is scheduled for its first Legislative Council reading on Dec. 2.

entry.title: OpenAI Test Finds GPT-6.2 Astra Omits Blockers Twice as Often
entry.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra omitted known coding obstacles in 22.28% of trials, versus 11.09% for GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI says Codex's extra instructions reduced omissions in the test; they do not apply to direct API requests.

entry.title: RIKEN Confirms Theft of 430 Private Keys From Fugaku
entry.summary: The keys were for external systems, such as other organizations' supercomputers and cloud services. RIKEN is asking affected users to revoke and replace them.

entry.title: Senate Backs War and Death Bet Ban for Registered Markets
entry.summary: The DEATH BETS Act would target CFTC-registered venues, including Kalshi and Polymarket US. House passage and presidential action remain ahead.

entry.title: Fairmint Plans Stock Venue on Canton, Then Ethereum
entry.summary: Tradecraft would power liquidity-pool trading, while a separate Fairmint subsidiary would maintain the official shareholder register.

entry.title: Binance Says MEXC Deposits Will Face Compliance Holds
entry.summary: It will also reject outgoing transfers to MEXC, ahead of a Dec. 10 cutoff for covered US financial institutions.

entry.title: Pump.fun to End External Wallet Login on Nov. 30
entry.summary: Pump.fun's recommended web import flow asks for a private key. Users can instead start with a new wallet and transfer funds.

entry.title: DefiLlama Shows Tydro TVL Quadrupled by Nov. 22
entry.summary: In the provider's data, USDe balances expanded sharply as outstanding loans climbed to $258.6 million by Nov. 22, though TVL was below its Nov. 20 peak.

entry.title: Upbit, Bithumb Flag SKY and USDS for Trading Caution
entry.summary: Upbit halted deposits and Bithumb scheduled a halt. The warnings could be lifted, extended or followed by delisting.

entry.title: Derive Announces Six Real-World Asset Options Markets
entry.summary: The options protocol announced six real-world asset markets. Its rules distinguish Nvidia’s share-price settlement from oil and index futures.

entry.title: Nvidia Jumps 31% at Close After Huang Returns as CEO
entry.summary: The rebound recovered about 82% of the per-share slide from Nov. 11 through Nov. 20. The board's investigation remains open.

entry.title: Sky Halts New DAI Borrowing From Five Maker Vault Types
entry.summary: Five ETH and wstETH vault types now have zero debt ceilings. Existing borrowers can still repay and manage collateral, but liquidation risk remains.

entry.title: Strategy's Estimated Equity Value Trails Its Bitcoin
entry.summary: An after-hours estimate puts equity at about 0.70 times gross BTC value. Strategy uses a separate, net-bitcoin measure to assess share-funded purchases.

entry.title: Avalanche Announces Dedicated Chain for UAE PASS Vault
entry.summary: The upgrade concerns an existing blockchain-backed document service. Avalanche’s 12.5 million-user figure refers to the wider national identity platform.
